title: Planned maintenance: nbn services connected via the Bendigo (VIC) POI
current_summary: A network provider will carry out a planned router software upgrade that may affect nbn services connected through the Bendigo POI in Victoria. The work is scheduled from 11:00pm AEDT on Wednesday 11 November to 6:00am AEDT on Thursday 12 November 2026. Services may be interrupted for up to 7 hours during this window.

cause.reason: Planned network router software upgrade by a network provider

updates.content: We have been advised that a network provider will carry out a planned router software upgrade that may affect nbn services connected through the Bendigo POI in Victoria. The work is scheduled between 11:00pm AEDT on Wednesday 11 November and 6:00am AEDT on Thursday 12 November 2026. Affected services may be interrupted for up to 7 hours during this window. We will share further updates if anything changes.
